comments.body: @pcbeingused333 Since the completions API is deprecated -- I think it can just be deleted. I think this is the case for most, if not all, other LLM providers as well.

@andreibondarev Done: `Anthropic#complete` is removed (with the `completion_model` default), so it now raises `NotImplementedError` from `Base`, and the branch is merged with `main`. One thing to know: `Chunker::Semantic`, the Ragas evals and HyDE call `llm.complete`, so with Anthropic they now raise `NotImplementedError` (they already failed before, with `NoMethodError`). I can move them to `chat` in a follow-up, and remove `complete` from the other providers whose completions APIs are deprecated, if you want.

> @andreibondarev Done: `Anthropic#complete` is removed (with the `completion_model` default), so it now raises `NotImplementedError` from `Base`, and the branch is merged with `main`. One thing to know: `Chunker::Semantic`, the Ragas evals and HyDE call `llm.complete`, so with Anthropic they now raise `NotImplementedError` (they already failed before, with `NoMethodError`). I can move them to `chat` in a follow-up, and remove `complete` from the other providers whose completions APIs are deprecated, if you want.

@pcbeingused333 Yep, I'd get rid of all "complete" endpoints. They're almost all deprecated.

@andreibondarev Done in 16fe6b7 (after merging `main`): `#complete` is now also removed from `OpenAI`, `Azure`, `Cohere` and `AwsBedrock`, along with their `completion_model` defaults and Bedrock's text-completion helpers. `OpenAI#summarize` now uses `chat`. README and CHANGELOG are updated, and the suite is green (749 examples) with standardrb clean.

I kept `#complete` in four places:
- `LlamaCpp`, `Replicate` and `AI21` have no `chat`, so `complete` is their only way to generate text.
- `Ollama`'s `/api/generate` isn't deprecated, and `Ollama#summarize` uses it.

If you want those gone too, I can do it here or in a follow-up. For AI21 that would probably mean dropping the class, since the Jurassic-2 models are retired.
Hi @andreibondarev, friendly ping: the points above should be addressed now. Could you take another look when you have a moment? Happy to change anything else.
